purpose: Emotional close-up on a line that is NOT on the lip-sync list, or the matched cutaway framing right before/after a Kling lip-sync clip. The mouth stays closed: on every non-lip-sync shot accidental mouth movement is a QC failure (choice-card-spec 3.6).
mouth_rule: Lips stay closed and relaxed for the whole clip; the performance lives in the eyes, brows, breath and a small head movement.
negatives: no mouth movement, no speaking or singing motion
no teeth-baring smile on a pain line
beats_pattern: settle (0-1.5 s) -> inner shift (eyes/brows) -> breath or swallow -> landing look that matches the next shot's first frame
lipsync_link: When this shot sits next to a Kling clip, its framing must equal the close-up picture's framing (chest-up, eyes to lens) so the cut is invisible.
